forum.title: Looking for a good source for learning stm32cubemx2 to start with STM32C5
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @tt2098 and welcome to the ST community,

You can start with this KB article: [STM32CubeMX2 and HAL2 basics](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32-online-courses/stm32cubemx2-and-hal2-basics/ba-p/887062)
forum.content_text:
Hello ,

**I was planning on using the new STM32C5A3RGT6 for my new project but after reading the comments regarding the stm32cubemx2 , i am reconsidering this decision. I also saw that zephyr is providing support for stm32c5.**

**My question would be then what would be a good source for learning stm32cubemx2 because coming from stm32cubeide 1.17 it is a big change.**
